binding_rule: Every artifact_id was resolved against its actual approved public episode; file SHA/bytes and each referenced JSON pointer or JSONL line were checked. No private raw text is copied into this index.
limitations: This index contains scalar outcome facts and public evidence locators; raw contents remain in the evidence package.
No Provider values, private source paths or private diagnostic input trees are copied.
Source episode and analysis hashes are original provenance claims; transformed public identities are recorded separately.
